attrs.text: Controls: run/step clock, reset input block
IN: A B C D E F G DP
Wire lanes use separated routes; keep block interiors clear
v2 Simon-4 structure: separated logic blocks
TOP BUS: wired LFSR -> decoder -> output/display
LOWER BLOCKS: bus ports shown; long unfinished buses are not expanded
Key inputs 1-8 through TT input block
IN: correct, display phase, score feedback
LEFT PORTS: CLK, write enable, lfsr[2:0]
FSM + input compare area (next: write enables, show/wait/check states)
LEFT PORTS: key bits + selected seq
Display phase counter: SHOW / GAP / WAIT / CHECK
Display controller: selected seq or blank/wait dot
Write mux: selected slot loads LFSR, others hold Q
